capabilities_done: Clip speed (src/varispeed.rs): ClipSpeed rational numerator/denominator (1/16..16, terms <= 65536, reduced, reverse flag); render_at_speed evaluates the band-limited source at the exact rational position m*r (u128 integer part + remainder, no drift) with a Kaiser-windowed sinc (Z = 64 zero crossings, beta = 0.1102 (100 - 8.7) for a 100 dB design stopband, table 4096 points per zero crossing with linear interpolation); stated band: cutoff 0.95 min(1, 1/r) of the source Nyquist, transition 0.1 of the cutoff, passband to 0.9025 and stopband from 0.9976 of the output-limited Nyquist; handles outside the clip window used; output_frames = ceil(frames / r); speed 1 forward/reverse are exact copies; TrackSpec::from_source_at_speed builds a session clip. Measured: a tone that would alias at speed 2 at -149.2 dB, a 0.999-Nyquist tone at speed 1/2 at -99.4 dB (stopband edge), images beside the wanted tone at speed 1/2 at -119.2 dB, passband amplitude at 0.84 output Nyquist 2e-5 dB, positions within 4.3e-7 at 6 speeds incl. 16 reverse and 1/16

time_stretch (src/stretch.rs): offline phase vocoder, periodic Hann N ~43 ms (2048 at 44.1/48 kHz, 4096 at 96 kHz), synthesis hop N/4 (squared-window overlap sum 1.5), integer analysis centres round(k H_s / factor) so the output is exactly round(len * factor), factor 0.25..4; identity phase locking (Laroche and Dolson 1999: peaks larger than two neighbours each side, regions split at the lowest bin, psi_b = psi_p + phi_b - phi_p); plain vocoder selectable. Measured: a 440 Hz sine keeps 440.00000 Hz and amplitude 0.50000 at factors 0.5/0.8/1.5/2/3 and 44.1/48/96 kHz; on an 8-harmonic tone stretched 1.37 the residual beside the harmonics is -65.81 dB locked vs -45.79 dB plain

pitch_shift: semitones -24..24 = stretch by the rational pitch_ratio (one term 65536, < 0.23 cent) then band-limited render_at_speed, output exactly the input length; measured within 0.0011 Hz of 440 * ratio at +12/-7/+3.5/-24/+19 semitones, amplitude within 0.004 dB

ClickRepair floor edges: besides exact zeros, a detection where the RMS of the 256 samples after it is >= 20 dB above (onset) or below (offset) the 256 before it is an edge, not a click (CLICK_EDGE_LEVEL_WINDOW, CLICK_EDGE_RATIO_DB); a click leaves the level unchanged and is repaired. Measured on 16-bit TPDF dither and a -60 dB white floor: abrupt starts/stops/restarts bit-exact (4 edges, 0 repairs each); 7 clicks on the floor and in the music all repaired, SNR improvement 32.58 dB, worst floor-click error 2.9e-5 (dither) / 9.5e-4 (white)
